permissions.name: payments:view
permissions.description: See payments, what they were for, and what happened to them

permissions.name: payments:create
permissions.description: Take a payment — start a new charge over the API

permissions.name: payments:capture
permissions.description: Capture or cancel a payment that was only authorised

permissions.name: payments:refund
permissions.description: Refund a payment, in full or in part

permissions.name: payments:settings
permissions.description: Change the payment provider and its API credentials

settings.name: provider
settings.description: Which payment processor money actually goes through. Only 'stripe' ships today

settings.name: currency
settings.description: The currency a payment is taken in when the caller does not name one. ISO 4217, lowercase

settings.name: capture_method
settings.description: 'automatic' charges the card as soon as the customer confirms. 'manual' only authorises it, and somebody has to capture it before the hold expires

settings.name: stripe_publishable_key
settings.description: Stripe publishable key (pk_test_… or pk_live_…). This one is meant to be seen — it is what the payment form in the browser is built with

settings.name: stripe_secret_key
settings.description: Stripe secret key (sk_test_… or sk_live_…). Encrypted at rest and never sent to a browser

settings.name: stripe_webhook_secret
settings.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_…). Without it every webhook is rejected, and no payment is ever confirmed

groups.name: kempo-payments:operator
groups.description: Handles payments day to day — looks them up, captures authorisations and issues refunds — without being able to see or change the API credentials

groups.name: kempo-payments:administrator
groups.description: Everything an operator can do, plus connecting the site to a payment processor
